Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond. About Us: SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy. Reports To GP Foreman Background The General Purpose (GP) Operator will exhibit a high standard of safety behavior and will ensure that all aspects of shipboard maintenance, rigging, slinging, painting and preservation, storage, housekeeping, and general duties are carried out safely and effectively. Authority The GP Operator has authority to carry out shipboard maintenance under the direction of the GP Foreman. The GP operator will ensure the safety of himself, team members, visitors and subcontractors within the limits of his responsibility. Immediate Subordinates Visitors, subcontractors Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards 1) Develop And Maintain Effective Working Relationships 1 Establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and visitors to the working environment. 2 Establish and maintain effective communications with colleagues and supervisors. 3 Carry out accurate and effective work handovers. 2) Conduct Slinging and Rigging Operations 1 Check preparation of loads for lifting. (Load is secure and stable) 2 Use various lifting items (plate clamps, barrel lifters chain hoists etc.) 3 Perform bundling and slinging of simple and awkward loads 4 Maintain slinging equipment (slings, hooks, webbing plate clamps, barrel lifters chain hoists etc.) 3) Perform Effective Signaling/Communications 1 Direct the movement and placing of loads using appropriate hand and radio communication techniques 2 Rig, sling and position blind load using appropriate hand signals. 3 Rig, sling and position blind load using radio communications 4) Perform Preparation And Cleaning Of Equipment For Maintenance Or Coating 1 Prepare the site for abrasive blasting and clean surfaces using abrasive tools 2 Paint or coat the worksite using correct colors, paints or protective coatings. 3 Examine portable power and hand tools before and after use reporting any defects immediately 4 Restore the worksite after cleaning and coating 5) Contribute to The Health and Safety of the Working Environment 1 Work area within your own responsibility is kept clean and free of hazards. 2 Positive action is taken to stop hazards and unsafe behaviors 3 Alarms are raised as appropriate and/or acted upon using applied policies and procedures or initiative 4 All potential and actual incidents are reported to the relevant supervisor 5 Record maintenance activities and report defects immediately and effectively 6) Monitor And Maintain Pollution Control Measures 1 Controlled process or utility discharges from the area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits 2 Unplanned discharges are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to Management System guidelines. 3 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are segregated properly and dealt with according to the correct procedure. 7) Emergency Response 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill). 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises. Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies Offshore - Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Offshore - Emergency Response Offshore - Slinging and Rigging Operations Offshore - Perform Fabric Maintenance Offshore - Safety Management Offshore - Confined space entries Offshore - Waste Management Offshore - Radio Procedure Pre-hire Qualifications And Experience Certification as per STCW Reg A II/5 or equivalent. Over 2 years’ experience in a deck capacity in the offshore or shipping industries. Rigging and Lifting Certified. Banksman Slinger Certified. Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore. GENERAL INFORMATION If you are interested and meet the requirements to perform this role, please apply via: Our website – www.sbmoffshore.com At this time, we are seeking candidates who are Guyanese and living in Guyana. We wish to thank all applicants for their interest. Please be guided that only selected candidates will be contacted. For more information on SBM Offshore, please visit www.sbmoffshore.com

The role covers financial management across our different legal entities, including group reporting and consolidation, budgeting and forecasting, cash-flow management, financial controls, project profitability and management information. In addition to Finance, you will provide management oversight of People & Culture, Corporate Operations and Procurement, working closely with the President, CEO, Head of Business and other senior leaders. This is a hands-on role suited to someone with a strong financial background who enjoys bringing structure to a growing international organisation, improving how information is used for decision-making, and finding better ways to run internal processes. Key Responsibilities You will: • Lead the Finance function across MDx CRO and coordinate financial activities across our different legal entities • Prepare monthly management accounts and consolidated financial reporting for Executive Management • Lead the annual budgeting process, rolling forecasts and periodic reforecasts • Maintain and develop the group business plan and financial scenarios • Monitor revenue, gross margin, EBIT, operating expenses, personnel costs and other key financial indicators • Manage cash-flow forecasting, treasury, working capital and financial planning • Oversee accounts receivable, collections, accounts payable and supplier payments • Coordinate intercompany transactions and reconciliations across the group • Coordinate external accountants, auditors, tax advisers and other financial service providers across different jurisdictions • Support statutory accounts, audits, tax filings and other financial obligations • Develop management dashboards and improve the quality and timeliness of financial and operational reporting • Monitor project profitability and support improved visibility of project financial performance • Support headcount planning, personnel-cost forecasting and recruitment decisions • Work with the Head of Business on revenue forecasts, pipeline assumptions, pricing and margin analysis • Provide financial analysis to support strategic, investment and operational decisions • Maintain appropriate financial controls, approval processes and segregation of duties Corporate Operations You will also: • Provide management oversight of the People & Culture function while day-to-day HR activities remain with the People & Culture team • Support workforce planning, headcount management and personnel-cost budgeting • Provide financial oversight of payroll, compensation reviews, salary structures, benefits and bonus frameworks • Review HR KPIs and support the development of efficient People & Culture processes • Coordinate key corporate and administrative processes across the organisation • Provide oversight of procurement, purchasing controls, major suppliers and recurring corporate expenditure • Support the coordination of external employment, corporate and other professional advisers when required • Help ensure that internal processes remain efficient and appropriate as MDx continues to grow Process Improvement and Automation A key part of the role will be improving how MDx operates internally. You will: • Identify financial and administrative activities that can be simplified or automated • Reduce unnecessary manual reporting and spreadsheet-based processes • Improve the consistency and reliability of management information • Work with internal teams to improve integration between Finance, HR, project-management and other corporate systems • Promote the appropriate use of automation, AI and digital tools to reduce administrative workload • Establish clear ownership and efficient workflows for recurring corporate activities • Measure whether implemented improvements generate meaningful time savings, cost reductions or improvements in information quality Requirements Must-Have • Approximately 7+ years of relevant experience in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Audit or Financial Advisory • Strong experience in financial management, management reporting, budgeting and forecasting • Experience preparing or coordinating monthly financial reporting • Good understanding of cash-flow, treasury and working-capital management • Strong analytical and financial-modelling capabilities • Experience working with multiple legal entities, international operations or group reporting • Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with financial and management information systems • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline • Advanced written and verbal English • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in an international environment • Availability for remote work with occasional in-person activities Nice to Have • Previous experience at a Big Four firm or another recognised audit, accounting or financial advisory firm • Experience combining an audit or advisory background with an internal corporate Finance role • Experience with group consolidation • Experience working across the US, the UK, Portugal, Spain, or other European jurisdictions • Experience in professional services, consulting, CRO, MedTech, life sciences or another project-based organisation • Experience with ERP, HRIS, CRM or project-management systems • Experience improving or automating financial and administrative processes • Exposure to People & Culture, procurement or broader corporate operations • Professional accounting or finance qualification, such as ACCA, ACA or equivalent Why Join MDx CRO At MDx CRO, you will join a specialised and growing international organisation operating across the MedTech and IVD sector. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of Finance while having direct exposure to Executive Management and a broader view of how the company operates. You will benefit from: • Direct collaboration with the President, CEO and senior management team • Responsibility across multiple international entities • A high level of autonomy and ownership • The opportunity to shape financial reporting, internal processes and corporate operations • The opportunity to introduce automation and better ways of working • Exposure to a growing international MedTech and IVD organisation • Professional and career development as the company continues to grow • Potential progression towards a Finance Director or CFO position About MDx CRO MDx CRO is a specialised Contract Research Organisation supporting medical device, in vitro diagnostic and precision medicine companies across clinical research, regulatory strategy, quality assurance and related services. We work with companies ranging from emerging MedTech organisations to global healthcare companies, supporting the development and delivery of medical technologies across international markets. Our Principles Make it POSSIBLE Make it WIN-WIN Keep IMPROVING Keep GROWING Keep it DIVERSE Our Vision To democratise access to world-class regulatory and clinical strategies, ensuring safer and more effective medical technologies for all. Our Mission We pioneer emerging technologies and navigate uncharted territories to redefine the future of the medical sector. Grow with Us If you are looking to take ownership of an international Finance function, work closely with senior management and help shape how a growing organisation operates, we would be pleased to hear from you.

review_candidates.title: Finance Specialist
review_candidates.description: About Us: Xiangyu Brasil is the Brazilian subsidiary of Xiamen Xiangyu Co., Ltd., a supply chain company listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange and part of Xiangyu Group, a Fortune Global 500 company founded in 1995 in Xiamen, China. The group provides integrated supply chain services worldwide, covering agricultural products, metals and minerals, energy, chemicals and forest products, supported by its own logistics network. About the Role: We are seeking a Finance Specialist to join our business area and support our export and import operations day to day, from deal structuring to the final booking, tax treatment and reporting of each shipment. Responsibilities: Export and import taxes and compliance Define and check the tax treatment of each operation: ICMS (export exemption, import ICMS and credits), PIS/COFINS and IPI where applicable. Control special regimes and incentives (Drawback, REINTEGRA, state ICMS benefits) and recover export tax credits via PER/DCOMP. Review the trade information in SPED (EFD ICMS/IPI, EFD-Contribuições) and other ancillary obligations with the external accounting firm. Handle transfer pricing for trades with related parties abroad (Law 14.596/2023) and assess the impact of the Tax Reform (CBS/IBS) on trade flows. Trade accounting Book commodity purchase and sale contracts, shipments and inventory in transit, with revenue recognition by Incoterms (FOB, CFR, CIF). Account for FX variation on export receivables and import payables, and for exchange contracts (ACC/ACE, spot). Reconcile trade accounts (customers, suppliers, freight, insurance, port and customs costs) and prepare trade-related closing entries. Provide trade data for the monthly closing and for the IFRS reporting package sent to headquarters in China. Assist with budget preparation and control, and produce financial analysis and other financial reports. Business partnering Advise the commercial team before deals close on the tax and accounting impact of Incoterms, trade routes, payment terms and contract clauses. Review NF-e, commercial invoices, DU-E, DI/DUIMP, bills of lading and exchange contracts for consistency with the books. Build margin analysis per shipment or contract, including freight, insurance, port costs, FX and taxes, and support cash flow and FX exposure monitoring. Work with customs brokers, freight forwarders, banks, tax advisors and the external accounting firm on trade operations. Perform other tasks assigned by management. Requirements: Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field, with active CRC registration; postgraduate studies in Tax, Controllership or Foreign Trade are a plus. Experience: 5 to 10 years in accounting and tax, with hands-on experience in export and import operations, FX and tax credit recovery. Industry: Background in agribusiness, commodity trading or trading companies is highly desirable. Technical: Solid knowledge of foreign trade taxes (ICMS, PIS/COFINS, IPI, Drawback, REINTEGRA), trade documents (DU-E, DI/DUIMP, B/L) and Siscomex/Portal Único. Business exposure: Experience working directly with commercial or trading teams, and with Incoterms and exchange contracts. Group reporting: Experience reporting to a foreign parent company under IFRS is a plus. Tools: Advanced Excel and ERP experience (SAP, TOTVS, Oracle or similar). Languages: Fluent or advanced English; Mandarin is a strong plus. Profile: Business partner mindset, autonomy, attention to detail and comfort working across cultures and time zones.

review_candidates.title: Expression of interest for August 2027 - Teacher of Physical Education
review_candidates.description: Inspired Education is the leading global group of premium schools, with a portfolio of 125 premium private schools spanning 6 continents which utilise proven educational practices from every corner of the globe, ensuring over 95,000 students receive a world-class learning experience from Kindergarten to Year 13. In 28 countries, Inspired schools are individually developed and anchored in the vibrant cultures of their respective locations. They collectively form an international family of schools that nurtures each student's academic and personal development in a progressive, dynamic, and innovative learning environment. By joining our award-winning team of over 14,000 employees, you can work in state-of-the-art facilities alongside industry-renowned educators and leaders in some of the world's most desirable locations. We invest heavily in our team members who enjoy industry-leading professional development, exceptional career opportunities, and mobility across our group. ROLE SUMMARY: The British School of Bahrain (BSB) is a multi-award-winning school and one of the top international schools in Bahrain, educating children with demonstrable success for over 30 years. The school is rated “Outstanding” by Bahrain Quality Assurance (BQA) and British School Overseas (BSO). The British School of Bahrain is renowned for offering the best holistic UK-based education within Bahrain. BSB’s core values of Excellence, Responsibility & Individuality underpin everything that we do and are epitomised by our three pillars of Academics, Sports and the Arts. BSB delivers high-quality British education to around 2,600 students aged 3 to 18 years and employs 306 full-time staff representing 31 different countries who are carefully handpicked. BSB is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment. Successful candidates will be subject to an enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check/ICPC or equivalent and satisfactory pre-employment references. BSB is a vibrant and enjoyable place to work, and is renowned for its pedagogy, staff development and academic success. The value we place on individuality is evident in our inclusive and innovative teaching approach. Our curriculum is based on the National Curriculum for England and Wales, with some adaptations to the local context and offers IGCSE, BTEC and A-Level examinations. Our aim is to provide our graduating students with a passport to the best universities, colleges and careers around the world. We are seeking to appoint a Teacher of Physical Education to start in August, 2027. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Creating Engaging Lessons: Plan and deliver lessons that inspire and challenge all students and are in line with the school's curriculum, policies, and external assessment requirements. You will individualise and differentiate learning, ensuring each student is stretched, supported, and makes outstanding progress. Supporting and Assessing Progress: Regularly assess students' in-class and at-home learning, providing targeted feedback to drive progress and ensure all students are challenged and supported in reaching their potential. Building a Positive Learning Environment: Establish a classroom and school environment where students are invested in each other's flourishing, feel valued and supported, and are ready to take risks in their learning. Collaborating and Sharing Best Practices: Work closely with colleagues as an active member of our learning community, sharing best practices, collaborating with colleagues, and dedicating yourself to your own professional development to ensure the highest standard of education for our students. Contributing to School Life: Play an active role in the school's co-curricular programme, helping to create a well-rounded, enriching educational experience. From leading clubs to contributing to whole school initiatives, you will help shape the broader life of the school. Collaborating with Parents: Maintain open and constructive communication with parents, building strong partnerships that support students' progress so that each child feels like an individual, well-known and respected. THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE: A degree and PGCE or B.Ed or the equivalent. The degree must be in the subject taught or a closely related subject Experience teaching the British curriculum up to GCSE and A-level students is highly desirable Confidence with the use of ICT in teaching Enhanced disclosure from the DBS or equivalent, and who are committed to the welfare of all children High expectations and aspirations for all students A commitment to the overall development of young people An open-minded approach to their work, and willing to learn and develop A demonstrable love for what they do and a proven track record To be considered for this position, you will need to meet our qualifications and experience requirements. In return, we offer an attractive expatriate remuneration package, including a competitive tax-free salary, housing allowance, health insurance, annual flight and relocation assistance, and 2 free places for children. SAFEGUARDING STATEMENT: Inspired Education Group is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practices and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed. Visit our careers site for more information; https://jobs.inspirededu.com
